attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Image1 original small card is sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light and crop; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion. Only human anatomy becomes smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head/body, green-ringed black eyes, source-matching closed mouth. Preserve real source hair: thick dark brown swept high/back with side part and grey sides/temples, real dark brow hair, short dark upper-lip moustache, clean chin. Preserve black/dark navy open-lapel suit, white shirt and blue/dark tie visible at lower center beside note. No spectacles, cap or beard. ROUNDED CHIN immediately meets raised/broadened existing neckline, VERY SHORT BROAD neck transition and minimal throat exposure. No separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping or cream belly bib. Preserve actual OPEN-lapel suit or jacket and fastening, coherent front/rear collar overlap/contact shadow. Retain complete tilted dark frame, opaque grey backing and attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces opaque, alpha only outside complete card silhouette. No invented insignia/text/accessories. Fine primary details indistinct stay understated. Keep original highlight/shadow and exact card crop. Do not mirror head angle.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Bareheaded stern CLOSED-MOUTH bust with original small-card head angle (do not mirror it). Thick dark BROWN hair swept high/back with a side part and GREY sides/temples, real dark brow HAIR and short dark UPPER-LIP MOUSTACHE, clean chin. Black/dark navy OPEN-lapel suit, white shirt and BLUE/DARK TIE visible at lower center beside note. No spectacles, cap or beard. Keep original highlight/shadow and exact card crop.
Preserve exact source head angle and expression. Whole yellow area above raised/broadened neckline is one compact near-round head, with clearly rounded chin immediately contacting the very short broad collar transition, no additional separate neck shaft or pointed V. Image1 is the exact original small card; Image2 identity only. Fine markings indistinct in Image1 must remain understated, not invented as a readable symbol.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
